# Team Standards

<!-- GENERATED by `attest standards build` -- edit domain.standards.yml (or core.standards.yml), never this file. -->

All pull requests are reviewed against this document.
## 1. Code quality
- **code-quality-1** (S3): ruff check passes. ruff check must report no violations.
- **code-quality-2** (S3): ruff format passes. ruff format --check must report no files needing reformatting.
- **code-quality-3** (S2): Validate all external input. External input must be validated before it is used by application logic.
- **code-quality-4** (S2): Handle errors explicitly. Known failure modes must be handled explicitly, and exceptions must not be silently swallowed.
- **code-quality-5** (S3): Reference a ticket in TODOs. A TODO introduced by a patch must include a ticket reference.
- **code-quality-6** (S2): Block logic that produces incorrect data. A reproducible logic defect that produces incorrect data is an S2 merge blocker.
## 2. Testing
- **testing-1** (S2): Untested core logic fails CI. Every logic change includes tests that fail if the behavior breaks, enforced by the coverage gate.
- **testing-2** (S2): Test every logic change. Every logic change must include a test capable of failing when the changed behavior regresses.
- **testing-3** (S2): Require regression-sensitive tests. Tests count only when their assertions detect regressions in the business behavior, including relevant edge cases.
## 3. Secrets
- **secrets-1** (S1): No committed secrets. Secrets are provided through environment variables only, never committed to the repository.
## 4. PII and logging (example -- edit or delete this section)
- **pii-1** (S1): Do not write PII to logs. Logging must not contain full_name, email, birthdate, or other PII directly or indirectly; app.privacy.redact() must be used.
- **pii-2** (S1): Control egress of minors' data. Data belonging to minors must not leave the service without minimization and a documented legal basis.
## 5. Data retention (example -- edit or delete this section)
- **retention-1** (contextual): Declare retention for every dataset. Every newly persisted or copied dataset must declare its retention category in app.privacy.RETENTION_DAYS.
- **retention-2** (S1): Limit retention of minors' data to 90 days. Minors' data must not be retained longer than 90 days unless the pull request documents a legal basis.
- **retention-3** (S1): Minimize secondary copies of personal data. Secondary copies of personal data require a defined purpose and retention period and must contain only data needed for that purpose.
## Review severities

- **S1 -- blocks merge:** severe violations (PII exposure, committed secrets, data-retention or minimization violations involving minors' data).
- **S2 -- blocks merge:** logic bugs that produce incorrect data; core logic without effective tests.
- **S3 -- comment, does not block:** style, naming, refactoring opportunities.
